name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $87.4 on 25 Nov, 24% lower over a month; Hormuz flows reduced but no new 2 mb/d outage confirmed
state: Brent was near $87.4 early on 25 Nov, 4.9% lower on the week and 24% lower over a month, inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). It fell below $89 on 24 Nov, its lowest since 28 Aug, as signs of renewed US–Iran diplomacy and an IEA surplus forecast outweighed further tanker strikes in Hormuz (Trading Economics). No new outage above 2 mb/d is confirmed, so Watch holds.
for_you: Lower crude prices tend to feed through to UK pump prices over a few weeks, but supply through Hormuz remains at risk while attacks continue.

sources.title: Trading Economics — Brent crude oil news

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
